summary: Don Thurman died on Kit Carson Mountain
notes: Incident type and county not stated in source; AVSAR 2010 narrative (2010-09-19 search): Saguache County SAR requested AVSAR assistance; 5 AVSAR techs staged at the Baca Firehouse command post south of Crestone; a Saguache hasty team located the subject deceased — evidence indicated he had gotten off route the day before and fallen to his death. AVSAR techs released without deployment.
